body:
## Change

F1. Union latest persisted read beats before writing mount-time session snapshot. Sequential writes from two stale sessions no longer erase each other's read progress; key/format unchanged.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN opens two snapshots then writes distinct beats. Parent reviewed monotonic read-log contract and failure fallback, reran 5 read-log tests. Worker related: 10; contracts: 87, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. localStorage read-modify-write is not transactional: truly overlapping operations can still race. Other tab's live Skip set updates only on reload. No native multi-tab browser proof. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(story): preserve read progress across open sessions
